verdict.rationale: Instinct is documented as an autonomous personal assistant that proactively follows up on dropped threads and calls or texts the user. Hands-on reviewers corroborate background autonomy: it took on podcast booking follow-ups from its own email and pinged the reviewer only when needed, picked up a first task before being asked, and noticed an overdue medical appointment and booked it. Setup works by delegating in natural language over text, not through an automation builder. Unsanctioned autonomous actions, such as an unapproved email and an unwanted reservation, point to weak approval controls rather than any lack of background autonomy. Missing for 10: explicit user-configurable triggers, schedules or recurring-rule setup; documentation for managing, reviewing or pausing ongoing automations; approval or guardrail controls for autonomous actions.
